opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. Conn. Motion of appellee for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Judgment affirmed. Weber v. Aetna Casualty & Surety Co., 406 U. S. 164 (1972).
The Chief Justice, Mr. Justice Stewart, and Mr. Justice Rehnquist would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
